title: False Advertising
body: Claims that it’s free but it’s only for 7 days then you have to pay. Typical app where you have to pay for a subscription.

title: Most accurate snow forecasting from any app
body: Goes in depth on every stat and is by far the easiest to understand snow forecasting app

title: LOVE IT
body: It is simply just better than the other guys out there. Long free trial, 7-day snow forecasts, and so many cams all for free.

title: Fire
body: Solid forecasting app. A lot more accurate than the others

title: Pretty good app
body: Fire app, I get all the weather I need. The cams are also super good cause I can actually see what is going on.

title: Worth It
body: I chase powder and many of these other apps were over reporting the snow. I like how accurate this one is it makes it easy to know where to ski.
